---
title: "4.7 Review of Nominal DVs"
---

- Multinomial logit is a set of binary logit models for all pairs of outcomes
  - Multinomial logit can be ***overwhelming*** if you try to interpret in terms of the coefficients for outcome contrasts
  - The same tools for interpretation in binary logit can also be applied to multinomial logit
    - Predicted probabilities and MEs greatly simplify interpretation
    - These are usually what you care about anyway
- Plots of effects are often necessary to understand the patterns
  - Always make the plot to guide your understanding regardless of whether it ends up in the published paper
  - These also help reviewers understand the model results
